exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, cesarean section)
outcome: surgical procedures performed during relaparotomy (hysterectomy, vascular ligation, secondary suturing, rectus muscle repair, uterine rupture repair)
cohort: The study included 120 patients who underwent obstetric relaparotomy due to postpartum hemorrhage after either a cesarean section or vaginal delivery.
finding: The obstetric relaparotomy incidence was 0.44%, primarily indicated by intra-abdominal hemorrhage (83.4%) and most frequently occurring after cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Of all relaparotomies, 81.7% occurred after cesarean sections, while 18.3% occurred after vaginal deliveries.
